summary: Controls replay recording state. When the session state allows it, a championship/session flag plus session type 7 starts recording: it creates the replay directory, reads the current track name, builds the replay file path (append the serialization FileName constant), starts the recorder object via ThunkToFUN004b7300(this+2, path, 1), then drives and polls it with SingleFunctionDispatch_9800 / SingleFunctionCallWrapper_9860. State 2 sets a flag byte on the recorder sub-struct. Otherwise it shows a 'recording not available' message via TextLineWrappingAndRendering. Invoked by Game_Restart (0042d7a0).

local_names.v16: 128-byte track name buffer for the string-table lookup
local_names.v13: buffer used to strip the ini value delimiter

operations.description: SessionStateCheckWrapper(dword_7CD25C) gates whether replay recording logic may run at all.
Start-recording condition: (dword_7D0038 || dword_7D005C) is true AND dword_7C56A4 == 7 (championship/session flag plus session type 7); otherwise *this is set to 0 and the message path is taken.
On the recording path set *this = 1 to mark recording active.
CreateDirectoryAWrapper(v3) ensures the replay directory exists, where v3 is lpPathName or the byte_5EA438 default path when lpPathName is null.
TrackNameReader(v16, 128) reads the current track name into a 128-byte buffer whose first dword was seeded from off_5D2520.
BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, v16, byte_5EC4CC) looks the track name up; on a hit the matched string is copied into byte_5EC4CC, and sub_587DD0 copies it into the path buffer (limit 127).
sub_587C20(v13, asc_5D251C) locates the ini value delimiter in the copied string and truncates the buffer at it (the value part is dropped).
Append the replay file name: the first 4 bytes of FileName plus its byte 4 are written onto the end of the assembled path buffer v17.
ThunkToFUN004b7300(this+2, v17, 1) starts the recorder on the sub-struct; on a zero return *this is cleared to 0.
SingleFunctionDispatch_9800(this+2) then SingleFunctionCallWrapper_9860(this+2, dword_7D00A4) drive and poll the recorder; the poll result is the return value.
When the session state check fails, *this == 1 also routes to the recording-start block, so an already-active recording re-enters the path.
When the session allows recording but the start condition is not met, *this is forced to 0.

Message path (only when dword_7D0410 is not 5 or 6): BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, aReplayRecordin_0, byte_5EC4CC) loads the recording-status string, then TextLineWrappingAndRendering(&dword_7CD204, byte_5EC4CC, 2, 16909060) displays it to the player.
State 2: set the flag byte at (this[2] + 3968) to 1 on the recorder sub-struct.
Returns the recording state value v2; invoked by Game_Restart (0042d7a0).
